description: Vietnam's electronic funds transfer report, evaluated per transaction. Domestic transfers of 500,000,000 VND or more, or the equivalent in foreign currency, are reported to the Anti-Money Laundering Department (Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN, replaced by Circular 27/2025/TT-NHNN from 1 November 2025, which keeps the threshold); deadline of Article 37(1) of the Anti-Money Laundering Law 14/2022/QH15 (one working day). This table reports transfers both out and in; which institution reports which side is to be confirmed against the circular. International transfers (1,000 USD or more) are not covered: the event model does not yet say whether a transfer crosses the border

rules.description: A domestic transfer, out or in, of 500,000,000 VND or more
